lastResponse.text: I’m glad you told me. This sounds like a safety concern right now. If you might take an extra pill or you feel in immediate danger, call nine one one now. Please do not take another blood pressure pill until a nurse confirms your dose. Put the bottle in front of you and check the date and time on your last dose if you can. I can stay with you while you call 988 for immediate support.
